base_model_revision_note: PIN to an immutable commit sha before any shadow/candidate/production serving. 'main' is a moving ref and is NOT reproducible (see huggingface_model_lifecycle.md §3 and §5: pin a revision, never latest).
weights_note: V1 = base model + system prompt; the contract is the artifact. Fine-tuned adapters arrive at V3 under adapters/.

thinking.note: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 emits no reasoning trace. The client's <think>-strip remains as an inert safeguard for thinking-variant models; only the final JSON object is the Analyst output and it must validate against response_schema_file before use (a malformed output is rejected and the deterministic fallback is served).
